blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 17th Asia CEO Awards, presented by Santé Barley, will hold its grand finale on October 13, 2026, at the Manila Marriott Grand Ballroom, recognizing outstanding leaders and organizations across Philippine business. With the theme “Tough Times Don’t Last, Tough People Do,” this year’s celebration highlights resilience, leadership, and the ability to create meaningful impact amid changing business conditions. Among the special honorees are world champion boxer and former senator Manny Pacquiao, named Lifetime Contributor awardee for the private sector, and Agnes Devanadera, president and CEO of Clark Development Corporation, named Lifetime Contributor awardee for the public sector.
